The '''Bust of Saesee Tiin''' was a [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] bust of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. It was kept in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="IA: Busted" />
